addr: 2nd floor, Aloft, Cessna Business Park Sarjapur, Outer Ring Rd, near Marathahalli, Kaverappa Layout, Kadubeesanahalli, Bellandur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103, India

rev.t:
service is so good here. Very peaceful place. Ambience is so good too.
Very good experience for a family or friends.
Quality of food needs  a upgrade altho for the place what it is. …

It’s a beautiful open rooftop restaurant where you can enjoy a lovely sunset. The food tasted good, but the menu has very limited options and the place is quite overpriced. We ordered nachos, pizza, and a few non-veg dishes.

Exquisite fine dine experience.

Thanks Echo Lounge Bar @Aloft, Bengaluru. …
